message.content:
```python
import os
import dd4hep
from dd4hep import kernel, importConstants, Geant4, setupUI, setupTrackingField, EventAction, Gun, tracker, Physics

# Initialize the DD4hep kernel
dd4hep_kernel = kernel()

# Load geometry from XML file in DD4hepExamplesINSTALL
geometry_path = os.path.join(os.environ['DD4hepExamplesINSTALL'], 'DDDetectors/compact/Tracker.xml')
dd4hep_kernel.load(geometry_path)

# Import constants from the detector description
importConstants(dd4hep_kernel.detectorDescription())

# Set up Geant4 instance with tracker
g4 = Geant4(dd4hep_kernel)
tracker(g4)

# Configure user interface
setupUI(g4)

# Configure tracking field
setupTrackingField(g4)

# Configure event actions
event_action = EventAction()
g4.event_action = event_action

# Set up a particle gun: gamma, 5 keV, multiplicity 1
gun = Gun()
gun.particle = "gamma"
gun.energy = "5 keV"
gun.multiplicity = 1
g4.generator_action = gun

# Set up tracker
tracker(g4)

# Set up physics list, add particle groups and processes
physics = Physics()
physics.addAllHelper()
g4.physics_list = physics

# Execute the Geant4 instance
g4.execute()
```
